content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position at IIT Kharagpur is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position at IIT Kharagpur as per the latest notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the SRF role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in EE/EC/CS/IN/DA or related branches of Electrical Sciences with a valid GATE score and 2 years of experience, or a B.Tech degree in EE/EC/CS/IN or related branches with a valid GATE score and 2 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position is 32 years. Age relaxation may be provided as per sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the SRF post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position is up to Rs. 42,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the IIT Kharagpur SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position at IIT Kharagpur is entirely online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IIT/SRIC/R/AEH/2026/109.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position at IIT Kharagpur is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
